entries.notes: Kernel name 'Identity, Mission & Continuity' pulls CC-003 Identity & Continuity into a node whose section 8 domain is Constitution/Mission/Scope. Section 8 splits these across ordinals 01 and 02; the kernel merges them.

Section 8 assigns Identity & Continuity to ordinal 02. The kernel assigns ordinal 02 to 'Authority, Consent & Governance' and places Identity & Continuity in the same node as the constitution. Direct contradiction on the same ordinal.
Kernel 'Execution, Agency & Safe Action' omits Authorization, which section 8 places here and which the kernel's own contract areas 04/14 place elsewhere.

Kernel 'Truth, Provenance & Accountability' substitutes Truth and Accountability for Ledger.
Kernel 'Relationships, Retrieval & System Context' substitutes Relationships and System Context for Applicability and Smart Links.

Section 8 assigns NayaNET Architecture, Hub and Production Proof to ordinal 09. The kernel assigns ordinal 09 to 'Continuity, Experience & System Evolution' and contains no NayaNET/Hub/Production domain at all. Direct contradiction, and the omitted domain is the one the North Star calls the next big engineering target.
